name: City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, December 05, 2017 - 06:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Outgoing Mayor Plaque presentation
4.
Selection of Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
6.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
7.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
8.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 8 a-f be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of November 7, 2017
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #8b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #8c
d.
Adopt Ordinance No. 793, Code Amendment No. 2017-02 related to clarifying and expanding the City's existing prohibition on cannabis activities citywide
ORD NO. 793 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, amending Title XI of the Lomita Municipal Code to clarify and expand the City's existing prohibition on commercial cannabis activities citywide to cover both medical and non-medical commercial cannabis activities and declaring it a public nuisance and setting a separate penalty schedule for violations of the Chapter. (Second Reading)
ACTION: That said ordinance be adopted.
Item #8d
e.
Adopt Ordinance No. 794 establishing a Public, Educational and Governmental Access Channel facilities (PEG) Fee
ORD NO. 794 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, amending Title XII, Chapter 1, Section 12 of the City of Lomita Municipal Code, regulating State issued cable television franchises. (Second Reading)
ACTION: That said ordinance be adopted.
Item #8e
f.
Accept work and file Notice of Completion for the Narbonne Avenue Pavement Rehabilitation Project
ACTION: That the City Council:
1.
To accept the work performed by Palp Inc. dba Excel Paving Company, for the Narbonne Avenue Pavement Rehabilitation Project; and;
2.
Authorize the Public Works Director to sign the Notice of Completion (NOC) and release the 5% retention payment in the amount of $52,836.44, 35 calendar days after recordation of the NOC by the County Recorder's Office contingent upon no claims being filed on the project and the contractor posting an acceptable warranty bond; and
3.
Authorize the City Clerk to file the NOC with the County Recorder's Office.
Item #8f
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
9.
CONSIDERATION OF APPOINTMENT OF AN AD HOC SOLID WASTE SUBCOMMITTEE
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
ACTION: That the City Council appoint two council members to serve as members of the Ad Hoc Solid Waste Subcommittee.
Item #9
10.
APPOINTMENT OF COUNCIL MEMBERS ASSIGNMENTS TO VARIOUS ORGANIZATIONS
Item #10
11.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, December 19, 2017, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
